changes: Referrals: while referrals are open, a referral link sets a cookie with its code for 30 days, sent only to our Discord login. The game keeps a referral record for your account (code, play time toward a referral, boosts), erased when your account is deleted.

A referral counts only for a new account whose Discord account was at least 90 days old and which has played 5 hours on 2 days. The player who invited you sees your progress without your name, and only "cannot count" if it does not count.

Hold elections: to vote, your Discord account must be at least 90 days old, you must have played 10 hours on 3 days, and your character must have been a citizen of the hold for 7 days. The game keeps the days you played (the 120 most recent).
A Lead GM can strike a vote, giving a reason, and can undo it; you are told either way. The names of voters are forgotten when each round of voting closes.
Referrals and elections do not use your PC code or your IP address. The PC code is still used only for the ban check.
